description.en: Former province of Judaea under its new name; capital Caesarea Maritima; Jerusalem refounded as Aelia Capitolina.
description.ar: إقليم اليهودية السابق باسمه الجديد؛ العاصمة قيسارية البحرية؛ وأُعيد تأسيس القدس باسم إيليا كابيتولينا.
description.he: מחוז יהודה לשעבר בשמו החדש; הבירה קיסריה שעל הים; ירושלים נוסדה מחדש כאיליה קפיטולינה.

sources.quote: In 132 the emperor Hadrian decided to build a Roman colony, Aelia Capitolina, on the site of Jerusalem.
the name of the province of Judaea has already been changed to Syria Palaestina, it must be inferred that AE 1904.9 was written after the conclusion of the war in Judaea, i.e. in 136.
The first city coins displaying Syria Palaestina come from Neapolis Sebaste, and were minted under Antoninus Pius
No territorial changes occurred between Palestine and Arabia after the transfer of southern Transjordan, the Negev and most of the Sinai Peninsula from Arabia to Palaestina under the Tetrarchy.

description.en: Enlarged by the southern part of Arabia (southern Transjordan, Negev, most of Sinai).
description.ar: توسع بالجزء الجنوبي من العربية (جنوب شرق الأردن والنقب ومعظم سيناء).
description.he: הורחב בחלק הדרומי של ערביה (דרום עבר הירדן, הנגב ורוב סיני).

sources.quote: the transfer of southern Transjordan, the Negev and most of the Sinai Peninsula from Arabia to Palaestina under the Tetrarchy
It is clear that the province of Palaestina underwent several territorial changes in the 4th century ce, but the details and the chronology remain obscure.

notes.en: Some scholars have proposed repeated back-and-forth transfers of the south in 300–390 (rejected by Di Segni).
notes.ar: اقترح بعض الباحثين انتقالات متكررة ذهابًا وإيابًا للجنوب في 300–390 (يرفضها دي سيغني).
notes.he: חוקרים מסוימים הציעו העברות חוזרות הלוך ושוב של הדרום ב-300–390 (נדחה על ידי די סגני).

description.en: After the separation of Palaestina Salutaris in the south.
description.ar: بعد فصل فلسطين السالوتارية في الجنوب.

sources.quote: in 357–358 (or perhaps as late as the 390s) the addition was made a separate province under the name of Palaestina or Salutaris (later Palaestina Tertia)
Internal changes occurred in Palaestina, with the creation of Palaestina Salutaris ca. 357/8.

The office of governor of Palaestina Salutaris was discontinued for some years in the 380s, until the reconstitution of this province ca. 389/90, some years before the creation of Palaestina Secunda in the early 5th century.
until the reconstitution of this province ca. 389/90

notes.en: Di Segni (2018) dates the creation of Palaestina Salutaris to c. 357/8; its governorship lapsed for some years in the 380s and was restored c. 389/90. The northern division (Palaestina Secunda) followed only in the early 5th century, which is why the end date runs to 409 at the latest.
notes.ar: تؤرخ دي سيني (2018) إنشاء فلسطين السالوتاريس بنحو 357/8؛ وتوقفت ولايتها بضع سنوات في ثمانينيات القرن الرابع وأُعيدت نحو 389/90. ولم يأتِ التقسيم الشمالي (فلسطين الثانية) إلا في أوائل القرن الخامس، ولهذا يمتد تاريخ النهاية حتى 409 على أبعد تقدير.
notes.he: די סגני (2018) מתארכת את הקמת פלשתינה סלוטריס לשנת 357/8 בערך; הנציבות שלה הופסקה לכמה שנים בשנות ה־80 של המאה ה־4 וחודשה בשנת 389/90 בערך. החלוקה הצפונית (פלשתינה השנייה) באה רק בראשית המאה ה־5, ולכן תאריך הסיום משתרע עד 409 לכל המאוחר.
